summary: The exact candidate is test-only hardening on top of a prepared base that already contains upstream PR 32467's production fix. Its gfx950 JIT planner tests and independent adversarial cases pass, but its static regression rejects the historically valid barrier-based fix and its recorded git diff --check result is inaccurate.

tests.what_was_measured: All four candidate tests passed on gfx950, including 100 iterations of the reported 72x4 + 24x3 planner shape and CPU/GPU plan parity. Evidence: evidence/candidate-regression.log

tests.command: custom invocation of candidate _assert_gpu_matches_cpu for reversed, alternating, outlier, bs=2/31/32/33, and mixed E=32/33 cases
tests.what_was_measured: Nine independent GPU planner boundary/adversarial cases matched the CPU plan and retained bounded unique ragged IDs. Evidence: evidence/adversarial-gpu.log
Contrary to the candidate result.json claim, trailing whitespace exists in reports/j-d166451934c2/failing-before.log and passing-after.log.

tests.command: git show c9c96b63f765db4ac7c88e824a755851f1049e30 and git show 58124fb983136b903108c8ef1305c135eb7d376f
tests.what_was_measured: Actual upstream history: a barrier was first added to fix the race, then initialization was removed. The candidate static test would reject the first correct implementation. Evidence: evidence/upstream-initial-fix.diff and evidence/upstream-cleanup.diff

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 ran the checked-out JIT planner under PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; import and artifact paths are retained under evidence/.
native_rebuild_evidence: The DSV4 compress-plan JIT shared library was built from the candidate checkout and loaded from /job/.cache/sglang/jit/gfx950/sgl_kernel_jit_dpsk_v4_compress_plan/build-0bbc057a34dba450/deps-666e3e1963b72122/sgl_kernel_jit_dpsk_v4_compress_plan.so. No monolithic native build is configured or required by the test-only candidate diff.
remaining_counterexamples: A correct implementation retaining warp scratch initialization with a __syncthreads() before per-warp reduction is rejected by test_warp_extrema_have_one_writer_per_slot, despite being the initial upstream fix for the race.
The exact candidate fails git diff --check although its result.json records that command as exit code 0.
remaining_limitations: The original CUDA/H20 TP=2 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark graph-capture failure could not be run with one AMD gfx950 and no model weights.
The prepared recorded base already contains the production fix, so the original illegal-memory-access was not reproduced on that base.
HIP planner parity does not verify CUDA warp scheduling, full model graph capture, semantic accuracy, serving transport, or distributed execution.
